tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, so dev builds do not skip certificate verification. This is consistent with the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, so dev builds don't skip it. It also notes that this fits the recorded "HTTPS everywhere, no plaintext exceptions" decision.

The "verification on all builds" decision (#29) revoked the earlier one (#27). I left out the earlier decision and anything that came before it.
